next_action.rationale: Rule v18 logic is sound, but its output (split-reservation orders) is not reaching carrier pickup. Tracing how EXC-0921 orders flow from allocation through the handoff pipeline to carrier scheduling will pinpoint where the orders stop or fail—either in the metadata transmission, dock queuing, carrier feed integration, or scheduling logic. This isolates the root cause to a specific subsystem (allocation→carrier, dock capacity, or carrier integration).
